notifications.title: Real faces and company logos need your decision
notifications.detail: Your 2026-11-03 note on the Buffett Short asked for real faces and product logos. The hard rules forbid downloaded or copyrighted images, and real photos and logos also carry likeness and trademark risk (and YouTube's reused-content check). Tonight companies switched to name cards and labels on what they make instead of pun objects.
notifications.fix: 1. If you want this, decide the source (for example licensed or public-domain portraits and the companies' official press kits) and accept the trademark and likeness risk. 2. Change the 'no downloaded images' hard rule in CLAUDE.md and agents/policy.md yourself; agents can't. 3. Otherwise no action: name cards stay.

notifications.title: Long videos now play at tempo 1.25: two docs outside my lane still say 1.5
notifications.detail: Your 4 Nov note on L-20261104-01 ('speed is very fast') lowered the long-video tempo from 1.5 (~215 words a minute) to 1.25 (~180) in renderer/timeline/build.py, the long_story README and the word-count checks. CLAUDE.md ('tempo 1.5 (~215 words a minute)') and agents/studio.md line 88 ('tempo 1.5, about 215 spoken words a minute') are outside the improver's lane. Studio reads the README too, but its own page still asks for ~215 a minute, so its first scripts may run long.
notifications.fix: 1. In agents/studio.md line 88, change 'tempo 1.5, about 215 spoken words a minute' to 'tempo 1.25, about 180 spoken words a minute' (a 300-400 s video is about 900-1,200 words). 2. In CLAUDE.md's Two formats table, change 'tempo 1.5 (~215 words a minute)' to 'tempo 1.25 (~180 words a minute)'. 3. If 1.25 now feels slow, say so in a note and the improver will set it between 1.25 and 1.5.

notifications.title: Your note asks for Shorts of 30 s or more; the length test says shorter wins so far
notifications.detail: On 5 Nov you said the 27 s gym Short was too short ('like 30 at least'). Shorts take their length from the variant system (config/arms.json, owner-only): 20-27 s or 28-35 s. At 48 h, 20-27 s Shorts have a median of 908 views (n 5) and 28-35 s 133 (n 9), so the judge has made 20-27 s the default. The evaluator agrees: 25-29 s Shorts average 81% viewed. Agents can't change lengths.
notifications.fix: 1. To keep following the data: no action. 2. To set a 30 s floor anyway: in config/arms.json change dimensions.length.options to ["30-35"] and default to "30-35" (or raise lengthMinSec to 30 in Settings on the dashboard). 3. To test it instead: add "30-35" as a third option next to the other two.

notifications.title: Every Short now opens 'You think X? It isn't.': want it tested against the secret hook instead?
notifications.detail: Your 9 Nov note asked for the denial, and CLAUDE.md makes it the rule, so the number check now enforces it on every Short. But the data leans the other way so far: the 7 Shorts of 3-6 Nov that used exactly this pattern got 9-63 views at 48 h, while the October 'secret' hooks that state the surprise ('Billionaires almost never sell their stock. They borrow against it.') have a 708 median and are the variant system's default. Those November Shorts were also 28-35 s and partly board-style, so the hook isn't proven guilty.
notifications.fix: 1. To keep the rule: no action; I'll report the next Shorts' 48 h views. 2. To let the data decide: in config/arms.json add "you_think" to dimensions.hook.options and tell me in a note; I'll limit the denial check to Shorts whose arms.hook is you_think. 3. To drop it: say so in a note and I'll revert commit 8bffe46.
